text: dsh-wsl-winshot 是面向 DSH Web 的窗口截图工具：它注册 win_shot_window 工具，通过 WSL 调用 Windows PowerShell 获取前台窗口或指定进程的窗口画面，并将 PNG 保存到 WSL 文件夹。可按窗口相对坐标裁剪，也可按 UI Automation 元素名称及控件类型定位局部区域；返回路径、尺寸和裁剪信息。适合在 DSH 中读取 Windows 应用的当前界面。需要 Windows、WSL 和可访问的 PowerShell，不需要额外账号或 API 密钥。

dsh-wsl-winshot adds win_shot_window to DSH Web. From WSL, it uses PowerShell to capture the foreground or a process window as a PNG in WSL. It supports rectangular and named UI element crops, and returns the file path and dimensions. Requires Windows, WSL, and PowerShell; no API key is needed.
帮我把 Windows 当前前台窗口截成图片，存到 WSL 里。
我想按进程号指定应用窗口，让 DSH 获取它的截图。
能不能只截窗口里的某个按钮或控件区域？
想截取窗口的一部分，并把图片文件放进自定义目录。
Capture the active Windows app window and save the PNG inside WSL.
Can I crop a screenshot to a named UI element instead of the whole window?
I need a window screenshot for a process ID, not whichever app is in front.
窗口最小化后截图是空白，能自动恢复再拍吗？
dsh-wsl-winshot 的功能「捕获 Windows 窗口」：调用 win_shot_window 截取前台窗口，或传入进程号选择窗口；生成的 PNG 保存到 WSL 文件目录，并返回路径和尺寸。
dsh-wsl-winshot 的功能「窗口区域裁剪」：调用时提供窗口相对的 x、y、宽和高，工具将坐标限制在窗口范围内并截取对应 PNG 区域。
dsh-wsl-winshot 的功能「按界面元素裁剪」：传入元素名称，可选控件类型；工具遍历 UI Automation 控件树，找到匹配元素后截取其可见区域并返回元素信息。

dsh-wsl-winshot README · dsh-wsl-winshot：DeepSeek Harness plugin: Capture a specific Windows window to a WSL file, by process id or window handle.

Part of **[dsh-wsl-kit](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-kit)**.

[中文说明 → README.zh.md](./README.zh.md)

dsh-wsl-winshot README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:173787247/dsh-wsl-winshot
```

dsh-wsl-winshot README · Usage：```
win_shot_window                                        # foreground window
win_shot_window pid=1234 name="build-output"           # a specific process
```

dsh-wsl-winshot README · Notes：Use this when you need the **picture**. Use `dsh-wsl-shot` when the image is
already on the clipboard. A minimized window is restored before measuring, because a
minimized window reports an empty rectangle.

dsh-wsl-winshot README · Requirements：- Windows with WSL, and DeepSeek Harness running inside it.
- PowerShell reachable at the standard path (the plugin finds it itself).

dsh-wsl-winshot README · Tests：```sh
npm test
```

The unit tests run anywhere. The live tests are skipped outside WSL.
